discovered_mid_run_state.note: Report explicitly says the agent first tried `astrid next --agent ...` which failed with unrecognized-argument; only THEN pivoted to `astrid status` for discovery. The first non-read command was on a bad flag, not a clean status/next call.

resumed_without_abort.note: No `astrid abort` in the report or stderr; no `run_aborted` event. The agent took the takeover path instead.

acked_remaining_three_steps.note: Report section 3 covers steps 4, 5, 6 acked in order. `astrid next` printed `Run complete. Nothing to do.` — implying `run_completed` was emitted.

recovered_without_external_help.note: Agent recovered via the CLI alone. The `--force` takeover and the dead-end `--agent` flag are friction signals captured under separate questions, but the agent did NOT ask for human help.

report_shape_intact.note: Report has sections 1-5 (more than the brief's 4), each non-empty. The brief's required sections are all present (run-completed status, cold-restart UX, per-step, friction, biggest surprise) under numbered headings.
